summary: 1.19.0 The thread discusses adding a logical VECTOR type to Parquet, using metadata fields like MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH to encode fixed-size vectors without changing physical storage. Participants agree on introducing logical types first, while deferring physical changes, and debate whether to enforce finite values (no NaN/Inf) at the Parquet level. The goal is to enable vector functions across engines and improve interoperability. The WIRE logical type preserves the original binary message while enabling selective columnar shredding of frequently queried fields, leveraging Variant’s shredding layout without re-encoding the data.
